main_text.p: Syr. Hilaritas, Gaudium, ad Rom.12.8. פצה Chald. Clarum, nitidum, Iesa.18.4. Vel Candens, Scintillans.
פציחא, פציחא Chald. Villa, pagus, vicus. Plur. פציחין & פציחיא, פציחין.
פציחין Ch. Grandinati, punctis, notis, maculis notati, Maculosi, Hebr. בררים.
Syr. Pascha. Chal. פסחא. ם & ץ, pro natura litterarum homogenearum commutatis.
* פצם Pahel Ch. Diffringere, perfringere, Jerem.22.14.
פצימא פצים Ch. Folium, pagina libri. Plur. פצימין, emp. פצימי, פצימיא.
פצר Chal. Instare, ut Hebr. אנש רפצר Homo qui instat, id est, Repugnat, Resistit, 1.Sam.15.23.

פקר פם Ch. & Syr. Praecipere, mandare, jubere; Constituere, ordinare: In Targum fere forma Kal inusitata est: sed apud Syros frequens. Pahel פקר Idem: Item Commendare aliquem, Commendatitias scribere: Fut. ... , Aut ut vos scribatis, ut commendetis nos: aut, commendatitias scribatis de nobis, 2. ad Cor. 3.1. Aphel אפקיר Idem. Ithpeh. אתפקר vel Ithpah. אתפקר Praecipi, Mandari, Juberi: Item Committi, Deponi, Levit.6.4.
פקורא, פקורי Ch. Praeceptum, mandatum, jussum. Plur. פקוריא, פקורי.

page.notes: Syriac and Hebrew script in the Pahel/Fut. line and the Syriac headwords (first and fourth-from-last entries) could not be reproduced reliably; the Syriac forms are given as best read. Some Syriac letters in the verb line at "Fut." are illegible, ~12 letters.
